post.title: What actually helped my sleep after years of trying everything
post.body: Not selling anything, just what worked. Consistent wake time mattered more than bedtime. Cutting caffeine after noon helped but took two weeks to notice. cases.description: Balanced comparison of three tools with pros and cons, no links

post.title: Notion vs Obsidian vs Logseq after six months with each
post.body: Notion is polished and great for teams, but offline mode is a real drawback and it gets slow with big databases. Obsidian is fast and local-first; the learning curve is steep and plugins can break on updates. Logseq is free and open source but buggy at times and the mobile app lags. If you want collaboration: Notion. If you want ownership: Obsidian. Depends on your needs; there are pros and cons to each.

post.title: The 2-minute rule changed how I start my mornings
